fullContentHtml:
Short Information : Uttar Pradesh Public Service Commission (UPPSC) has released the notification for the Statistics Officer, Assistant Geologist Post. This recruitment has been issued for 06 posts. Online applying process for UPPSC Statistics Officer, Assistant Geologist Direct Recruitment 2025 has started from 20 June 2025 & the candidates can apply till 21 July 2025. Candidates must check the complete details for UPPSC Statistics Officer, Assistant Geologist Direct Recruitment 2025 which has given below. 

Uttar Pradesh Public Service Commission (UPPSC)

UPPSC Statistics Officer, Assistant Geologist Direct Recruitment 2025

UPPSC Advt No. : D-3/E-1/2025

Important Dates

  • Application Start Date : 20 June 2025
  • Last Date : 21 July 2025
  • Fee Payment Last Date : 21 July 2025
  • Correction Last Date : 28 July 2025
  • Receipt Hard Copy : 04 August 2025
  • Exam Date : Notify Later
  • Admit Card : Before Exam

Application Fee

  • General, EWS, OBC : Rs. 105/-
  • SC, ST : Rs. 65/-
  • PH : Rs. 25/-
  • Candidates have to pay their Examination Fee Through Debit Card / Credit Card / Net Banking / UPI and Other Fee Payment Mode Only.

UPPSC Statistics Officer, Assistant Geologist Direct Notification 2025 : Age Limit

  • Age Limit As On 01 July 2025
  • Minimum Age :  21 Years 
  • Maximum Age : 40 Years 
  • Age Relaxation as per UPPSC Statistics Officer, Assistant Geologist Direct Recruitment Rules.
  • Use Tool –

UPPSC Statistics Officer, Assistant Geologist Direct 2025 : Vacancy Details

Total Posts : 06 Posts

Exam Name No. of Post
Statistics Officer 04
Assistant Geologist 02

UPPSC Statistics Officer, Assistant Geologist Direct Bharti 2025 : Educational Qualification

Post Name No. Of Post
Statistics Officer
  • Candidates must have a Master’s degree in Mathematics, Mathematical Statistics, Commerce, Economics, or Statistics with at least 55% marks, or a Post Graduate Diploma in Statistics.
Assistant Geologist
  • Candidates must have a Master’s degree in Geology or Applied Geology, or a Diploma in Applied Geology from the Indian School of Mines, Dhanbad, with at least 50% marks.
  • For more eligibility details, please read the official notification carefully.

UPPSC Statistics Officer, Assistant Geologist Direct Online Form 2025 : How To Apply

  • Candidates can apply through link https://uppsc.up.nic.in/ or provided below in link section or they can also apply through official site of the UPPSC before Last Date.
  • You Can Check other Sarkari Result 2025 Notification Here – Check Now.
  • For all the interested and eligible candidates who want to apply for UPPSC Statistics Officer, Assistant Geologist Direct recruitment can read all the information related to the recruitment is given below and the link to apply is given in the Important Link section below.
